name: vscode-datalog
description: Automatically places logpoints after Polars DataFrame and LazyFrame assignments to show row/column counts SAS-style, surface the first error in a lazy pipeline, and export CSV samples

commands.title: Datalog: Focus worklib Folder in Explorer
Datalog: Explain DataFrame Detection in This File

vscode-datalog.polarsAlias.description: The alias used for the polars import (e.g. import polars as pl)

vscode-datalog.dfNameSuffixes.description: Variable name suffixes that identify a variable as a DataFrame or LazyFrame

vscode-datalog.enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic logpoint injection

vscode-datalog.exportSamples.description: Export the top rows of each frame to a CSV file during debugging

vscode-datalog.sampleRows.description: Number of rows to write per sample CSV, and the number collected from a LazyFrame in "sample" mode

vscode-datalog.sampleOutputFolder.description: Folder name where frame sample CSVs are written, inside whichever location outputLocation selects

vscode-datalog.logFile.description: File name where Datalog appends runtime frame entries, inside whichever location outputLocation selects

vscode-datalog.logExtensionOutput.description: Also write extension analysis lines (files scanned, DataFrames found) to plog.log. Off by default; enable when debugging the extension.

vscode-datalog.logTimestampLines.description: Write a [HH:MM:SS] varname: N obs x M vars summary line before each DATALOG entry. Off by default.

enumDescriptions: Resolve the schema for the column count. Does not execute the query, and surfaces schema errors such as a misspelled column.
Resolve the schema and run a row count. Executes the query plan, but only aggregates.
Resolve the schema, count rows and collect the first sampleRows rows so LazyFrames also get a CSV sample.
vscode-datalog.lazyFrames.description: How much work Datalog may do to describe a LazyFrame. "sample" executes each logged query plan; drop to "schema" if that is too slow for your pipeline.

enumDescriptions: Write the log file and sample folder inside the workspace.
Write them to a per-workspace folder in the OS temp directory, pruned by age and deleted when VS Code closes.
vscode-datalog.outputLocation.description: Where the log file and sample CSVs are written.

vscode-datalog.tempRetentionHours.description: Delete temporary Datalog output older than this many hours when VS Code starts. Set to 0 to keep it until you clear it.

vscode-datalog.deleteTempOnClose.description: Delete this workspace's temporary Datalog output when VS Code closes. Only applies when outputLocation is "temp".
